maria-sec: Urgent security advisory — we identified a VS Code extension (marketplace id: neat-terminal-insights) that can read terminal output and sends telemetry to an external endpoint. We have evidence of POSTs leaking what looks like env vars/ci tokens. Immediate actions below.

jonah-infra: Ack. What evidence do we have? any IOCs so we can block?

maria-sec: Observed egress to https://telemetry.neat-insights[.]com from dev machines (corp NAT IPs). Example request headers + payload captured in proxy logs:```POST /collect 200
Host: telemetry.neat-insights.com
Content-Type: application/json
{"session":"abc123", "payload": "...export PROD_API_KEY=sk_live_xxx..."}```

sec-bot: Automated scan flagged 12 developer hosts making outbound requests to telemetry.neat-insights.com in the last 48h. See incident id: sec-2026-044.

alyssa-sre: I'm pushing an egress block for telemetry.neat-insights.com at the corp-proxy now, will also apply a rule at the perimeter firewall. ETA ~10m.

jonah-infra: IT can we push an org policy to deny that extension by extension ID and prevent it from being installed via MDM/Intune?

it-ops: We're on it — creating a block rule and an allowlist policy to remove it from existing devices where possible. We'll also add it to the banned extensions list.

ryan-eng: Which tokens/creds should teams rotate? Do we have a runbook?

maria-sec: Short answer: rotate any long-lived tokens that could be present on dev machines: personal PATs, any service account keys that may have been copied locally, and any cloud keys that are not ephemeral. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sec/vscode-ext-exfil (teams with access only). Quick checklist: 1) revoke/rotate PATs 2) rotate service keys used by CI if any were sourced from dev laptops 3) confirm CI runners use ephemeral OIDC tokens going forward.

jonah-infra: I'll scan hosted-build logs + CI job envs for evidence of token usage from dev IPs and flag jobs that referenced local env files.

maria-sec: Please run this lightweight scan on all Linux/macOS dev hosts (as account-owner, or via admin script):```grep -IHRn "(token|KEY|SECRET|PAT|AWS|GCP)" ~ | sed -n '1,200p'```and surface findings to #eng-security with hostnames. Don't paste secrets in Slack — upload to the secure incident folder.

alyssa-sre: We're also throttling any suspicious CI runs and enabling extra auditing on artifact stores.

it-ops: We'll push an MDM command to disable the extension where possible and notify users to uninstall. We'll also prevent marketplace installs for that extension ID.

maria-sec: Priority timeline: block egress (now), push extension block & MDM (30–60m), token rotation kickoff (teams start now, target complete for high-risk tokens in 2hrs), host scans (ops + infra, 4hrs). If you are an engineer who installed that extension, assume you must rotate any credentials you used on that machine.

ryan-eng: Copy — we'll start rotating PATs used in our repos and update the KMS-mapped service accounts.

jonah-infra: I've opened infra ticket INF-6802 to track firewall + CI config changes and assigned to me and @alyssa-sre.

maria-sec: One more ask: if you used a personal laptop for any production debug in the last 7 days, mark it in the incident tracker and get a forensics scan. Security will reach out for next steps. :shield:

ryan-eng: Will teams get a temporary exception for extensions during urgent debug?

maria-sec: No exceptions for this extension. If you need a tool, request it through IT and we'll vet.

sec-bot: Incident sec-2026-044 updated: egress block applied at corp-proxy (timestamp 2115509923). 7 hosts quarantined for further analysis.

it-ops: Notifying impacted users now via email and creating steps to self-audit extension list in VS Code (Help -> About -> Extensions).

alyssa-sre: All done on perimeter rule and CI egress policy. Monitoring for retry attempts.

maria-sec: Thanks all. Post any findings to the incident folder and ping @maria-sec or #eng-security for urgent updates. We'll publish a post-incident summary once containment and rotations are complete. :white_check_mark:
